about_the_game:
Brew a cup of tea and set out on a new journey filled with a sense of retrofuturism aboard the Cititon space station. Here, you will move closer to uncovering the secrets of the mysterious Ancient race and help those who still remain on board.

Episode 2 continues the story while preserving the familiar visual style, gameplay with puzzles and mini-games, and an atmospheric musical score.

But be careful — it’s not only the robot Lecto who may be lurking in the shadows…
detailed_description:
JOIN OUR DISCORD!


About the Game

Brew a cup of tea and set out on a new journey filled with a sense of retrofuturism aboard the Cititon space station. Here, you will move closer to uncovering the secrets of the mysterious Ancient race and help those who still remain on board.

Episode 2 continues the story while preserving the familiar visual style, gameplay with puzzles and mini-games, and an atmospheric musical score.

But be careful — it’s not only the robot Lecto who may be lurking in the shadows…
